name: XDKNet 3.0.1.1
body:
XDKNet 3.0.1.1 is a small update to 3.0.1.0, which brought in Moonfin 3.1.1.
Update the server plugin to 3.0.1.1 along with the app.

## Smart Search

- While the server is still downloading Smart Search's model or indexing the
  library for the first time, search no longer shows a Smart Search row of
  rough guesses. The usual results show on their own, and the row comes back
  once the index is ready.

## Home and Settings

- The Settings preview draws Modern posters at the size Home does, at every
  card size.
- On a phone, tapping a Modern card moves the rows under it down to make room
  for its details, instead of covering them.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the Android TV APK below.
